objectives.text: Rebuild after Hurricane Melissa on borrowed money. Five international lenders, the IMF, World Bank and Inter-American Development Bank among them, put together up to US$6.7 billion over three years at Prime Minister Holness's request; the World Bank and IDB put the physical damage at US$8.8 billion, and US$662 million arrived at once. The figures are from the search summary of the Gleaner article, not from a full read.

objectives.text: Keep Washington's goodwill while ending the Cuban medical programme. Jamaica ended its roughly 50-year medical cooperation with Cuba in March 2026, after the two governments could not agree new terms. Holness defended the decision; Havana said Kingston bowed to US pressure; the foreign minister denied any US pressure. The objective is our reading of the act, not a stated aim.

paradoxes.text: Dropping the Cuban programme to stay in Washington's good books lands in the rebuild. Havana says its brigade stayed at its posts for more than 72 consecutive hours after the storm, and the US congressman who welcomed the cut had earlier criticised Holness.

grand_strategy.reading: Jamaica is a small, indebted state whose rebuild after Hurricane Melissa now runs through lenders and CARICOM rather than its own means. Its clearest foreign-policy act, ending the Cuban medical programme, is read in Havana as Washington's price, and Kingston denies it, which is the ambiguity a small state buys with. This card is thin on purpose: the United States, United Kingdom, China and CARICOM postures, and the economy and gangs, wait for sources the card has not yet read.

stances.note: Transactional cooperation with Washington, no alignment. The clearest signal is the March 2026 end of the Cuban medical programme, which a US congressman who had criticised Holness welcomed; Havana says Kingston bowed to US pressure and the foreign minister denied it. No US government statement and no security-cooperation or aid row was read, so the grade rests on tier 3 press only. Our reading: bond none, since nothing in the sources shows a kin or affinity tie. Trend stable pending a read of the aid and security record.

stances.note: Commonwealth partner with the monarchy still as head of state: Holness told the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge in 2022 that Jamaica was 'moving on' and intended to fulfil its ambitions as an independent country, and the UK announced aid packages after Hurricane Melissa (Wikipedia index, tier 4, pointer only). Bond kin is our reading, not a source's: shared language, Commonwealth and monarchy history. Confidence C because the only source is the tier 4 index; no UK government statement was read. Since is the 2022 royal visit, the earliest dated line in the sources.
